text: フエンめいぶつの　せんべい。
note: Senbei are traditional Japanese rice crackers, and Japanese tourist towns, hot-spring resorts especially, sell their own senbei as the local specialty souvenir (meibutsu). The English game dropped the cracker and calls the item a cookie.
claim: Senbei are traditional Japanese rice crackers that are commonly sold as local specialty souvenirs in Japanese tourist and hot-spring towns.

check.quote: 炭酸せんべい（たんさんせんべい、炭酸煎餅）とは、兵庫県豊岡市の城崎温泉、兵庫県神戸市の有馬温泉、兵庫県宝塚市の宝塚温泉の名産とされる菓子である。
